title: 第1170章 道侣考核第1169章 前往烈阳峰
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
整个悟道广场阳罡弥天，灼热霸道的纯阳场域充斥八方，每一寸空气都裹挟着厚重的威压，一般修士立足此地便会身体发沉、真元滞涩，根本无法久驻。
而越往中央，那源自烈阳大道原石的威压便越是恐怖，仿佛有一轮实质化的煌煌大日悬于头顶，阳炎焚天，道则如刃，连虚空都被灼烧得微微扭曲。
寻常真神踏足中央，都难以扛住这极致炽烈的大道碾压，神片刻便会道基灼烧、被迫退离。
而此刻。
李易却完好无损地端坐于中央那最大的悟道石碑之前，静心悟道。
这一幕。
让整个广场苏醒的修士心神巨震，无论修为高低，皆呆呆凝望那道身影，心底掀起滔天巨浪，全然不敢相信眼前所见。
“他区区一个准神，怎能待在至尊圣碑前悟道？那里连真神都不敢久留啊！“
“太离谱了！普通真神在那待片刻，便会肉身灼烧、神魂受创，他却安然静坐，甚至还在主动吸纳烈阳道韵！”
“之前我还以为他是靠圣女庇护的庸人，如今看来，是我们所有人都看走了眼！”
“这老家伙绝非表面这般艰难，他能登上八重天梯，踏入凤凰池神君领域，必然有这深厚底蕴与根基，难怪圣女明知宗门上下非议，依旧力保他！”
……
众人议论纷纷，先前的轻蔑与嘲讽渐渐散去，取而代之的是浓浓的震撼与惊诧。
“果然是个深藏不露的主儿。”
姚红姬美眸微眯，凝视着那道端坐于烈阳石碑前的身影，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的弧度，
“我倒是越来越好奇，你这副皮囊之下，究竟还藏着多少不为人知的秘密。”
一侧。
赵天海面色肃然，双拳暗暗握紧。
他盯着端坐于至尊圣碑前的李易，眼中闪过一抹难以掩饰的忌惮与嫉妒，身为天神后期的绝世天骄，他岂能在一个准神面前丢了颜面，何况昨日还败给了对方。
一番思索后，他出声反驳：

“圣女不必过高估量此人。
依我所见，石凡能稳坐那块圣碑之前，并非根基深厚、底蕴通天，而是仗着肉身强横，加之身怀阴阳道种，恰好能化解烈阳场域的灼烧威能。”
他顿了顿，继续道：
“说白了，不过是借外物之利罢了，算不得真本事。”
此言一出，四周之人顿时一副恍然大悟的模样。
“原来如此！我就说他一个三千岁才堪堪准神的老修士，能有多少底蕴积累？原来是阴阳道种之功！”
“嘿，我还以为真是什么隐世高人呢，搞半天是靠天赋体质硬撑。”
“一个靠外物立足的老朽罢了，不堪造就，没什么潜力。”
“就是，咱们这些天骄哪一个没有特殊体质？他这点优势算得了什么！”
……
众人长舒一口气，先前因李易表现而升起的压抑与不安，瞬间烟消云散。
他们自诩宗门天才，若在潜能方面败给一个寿元将尽的老杂役，那才是奇耻大辱，此时得知对方不过是凭借体质取巧，心中那点危机感自然荡然无存。
姚红姬听得赵天海这番言论，忍不住撇了撇嘴，眸子中闪过一丝不以为然。
在她看来。
石凡绝非仅靠阴阳道种就能做到这一，那种在极致阳炎场域中悠然静坐、主动吸纳烈阳道韵的姿态，分明是自身根基雄厚到一定程度才能做到的。
content_en:
The entire Enlightenment Square is filled with yang, and the scorching and domineering pure Yang field fills all directions. Every inch of the air is packed with heavy pressure. When ordinary monks stand here, their bodies will feel heavy, their true energy will be stagnant, and they will not be able to stay for a long time.
The closer to the center, the more terrifying the pressure originating from the original stone of the Lieyang Avenue becomes, as if there is a substantial bright sun hanging above the head, the sun is burning the sky, the Tao is like a blade, and even the void is burned and slightly distorted.
Ordinary true gods would be unable to withstand the extremely fierce crushing force of the avenue when they set foot in the center. The gods would be burned in a moment and forced to retreat.
And at this moment.
Li Yi, however, sat intact in front of the largest enlightenment stone tablet in the center, meditating on enlightenment.
This scene.
The monks who woke up the whole square were shocked. Regardless of their level of cultivation, they all stared blankly at the figure. There was a huge wave in their hearts, and they couldn't believe what they saw in front of them.
"How can he, a mere quasi-god, stay in front of the Supreme Monument to realize enlightenment? Not even the true god dares to stay there for a long time!"
"It's too outrageous! Ordinary true gods will burn their bodies and hurt their souls if they stay there for a moment, but he sits quietly and even actively absorbs the Tao Yun of Lieyang!"
"Before, I thought he was a mediocre person who relied on the protection of the saint. Now it seems that all of us have misjudged him!"
"This old guy is definitely not as difficult as he appears. If he can climb the eighth-level ladder and step into the realm of the Divine Lord of the Phoenix Pond, he must have such a profound background and foundation. No wonder the Saint is still trying to protect him even though she knows that the sect is criticizing him!"
…
Everyone was talking, and the previous contempt and ridicule gradually dissipated, replaced by deep shock and surprise.
"He is indeed a secretive master."
Yao Hongji narrowed her beautiful eyes, staring at the figure sitting in front of the Lieyang Stone Tablet, and raised a meaningful arc at the corner of her mouth.
"I'm becoming more and more curious about how many unknown secrets you hide under your skin."
one side.
Zhao Tianhai looked solemn and secretly clenched his fists.
He stared at Li Yi, who was sitting in front of the Supreme Holy Monument, with a trace of unconcealable fear and jealousy flashing in his eyes. As a peerless genius in the late stage of the gods, how could he lose face in front of a quasi-god, let alone lose to him yesterday.
After some thought, he retorted:
“Saintess, don’t overestimate this person.
From what I can see, Shi Fan was able to sit firmly in front of that holy monument not because of his deep foundation and profound knowledge, but because of his strong physical body and the fact that he possessed the Yin and Yang Tao seeds, which was able to resolve the burning power of the Fierce Yang field. "
He paused and continued:
"To put it bluntly, it's just borrowing benefits from foreign things, it can't be considered a real skill."
As soon as these words came out, the people around him suddenly looked like they were suddenly enlightened.
"So that's it! Let me ask you, how much knowledge can a three-thousand-year-old old monk who is only qualified as a quasi-god have accumulated? It turns out that he is the result of Yin-Yang Taoism!"
"Hey, I thought he was some kind of hidden master. He only relied on his natural talent and physique to survive for a long time."
"He is just an old man who relies on external things to gain a foothold. He cannot be cultivated and has little potential."
"That's right, which one of our geniuses doesn't have a special physique? What does his advantage mean!"
…
Everyone let out a long sigh of relief, and the depression and anxiety that had arisen due to Li Yi's performance disappeared instantly.
They consider themselves to be geniuses in their sect, and it would be a great shame if they lose their potential to an old handyman who is nearing the end of his life. Now that they know that the other person is just relying on his physique to take advantage of the situation, the sense of crisis in their hearts naturally disappears.
When Yao Hongji heard Zhao Tianhai's remarks, she couldn't help but curl her lips, and a trace of disapproval flashed in her eyes.
In her opinion.
Shi Fan was definitely not able to do this just by relying on Yin Yang Dao. The posture of sitting leisurely in the ultimate Yangyan field and actively absorbing the yin of Lieyang Dao was clearly something he could only do if he had a strong foundation to a certain extent.
